content: Yanu torowa yanu meana yawoegou ufe
Naiyemutu, ya nesia tisa uwara siboe da imuawe. Godima ya tisa uwaranu ueta eregou ufiro ya da we mawetu uegou ufeisina sina kimuwere webisu. Nono i tisa me uwaraba sina kimuwere da webisu.
Ya nesia siosawere utaisi. Anama danu bebetu yawoegou uteda sina siosa wiawa utasuna dawana kobererau. Dawa danu ofe nesia yawoegou utasu.
Yana osi egi ma owefene aiyoni danu bebetu ubarero odeda yanu unu dabaro anibie ma youraisiro owereda yanu unu dabaro anasu.
I dera boutiwere eawe. I boutinu ma boboretana kikiratu. Oyau derawere fareibisuroma i bouti ubi amarama iro maibiro bouti i amaranu unu dabaro anibisu.
Yareta ina kikiratuma koe derawere yarasu, enanari yanu meanana kikiratu nono i meanama sina derararabo webasu.

Yanu meanana ina yareta ari. Ina yanu ofero mui emetu. Ina i nasiniro siosawere ueta nesia ari. Seitanima i yawotasuba ima sina derawere webe webe eno uteda yanu ofe inama yanono utasute yanu ueta sineta nesia ma siosa utasu. Yana kikiraturoma eno utebaisi.
Emema egini gasiraini towini erio egini ema nesia ma tanama ue yawoteda nono i meanana ma tanama ue yawotawa utaita. Yanu meanana kae ari.
Yanu meanama Baba Godiba we ma kobererau utaisite nono yanu meanama eme, emana Godi ari, emaba sina siosawere waisina iba Godiba siosa sina waisi.
Meana demuraima we ma kobererau uetaini sina siosa wetaini farasuro wasu. Naiyemutu, ina ba me.
Erio ubiroma kobere ogoini siosawere ogoini arotorowa farawa utaisi.
Boruba anaro oriwa ana tai uwanawa utebasuro gureifi na didiro boruba tai uwanawa utebasu. Nono enanari i enea ubarero ba ogo ibawa utasu. Nono yanu meanama sina kobererauini siosawereini eno waisi.
Yabai abo amarana iwata derawerero beforo buna amara? I amarama danu ueta sineta kobererau uteda na eawe da webisuna dawana iwata derawerero beforo buna amara.
Yana imueta jaja bobo utaitate yanu torowa ma derawere ufoe utaitate na beforo buna amara waitana ina ba meba eno da uawe.
Eno imutaitana ina Godinu iwata me. Ina emenu iwata. Eno imutedana Godinu imueta imutawa utaitate seitaninu imueta imutaita.
Yana emeba yanu imueta jaja bobo sina webote eme ma kikiratu ufote yanu torowa ma derawere ufoitana kerere derawere ido uyafiro ba mewere ufoita.

Godinu imuetana kobererauba yana urero Godinu imueta imutaitana kobererau uegou uteda urane yarane utawa utaitate emeba kobererau utaitate emenu sina nautaitate emeba neno arama utaitate yanu imueta uro owere ma owere utawa utaitate ba sina torowa webaita.
Anama moana uwaraini urane yarane utawa utasute sina kobererau wasuna i amarama danu siosa ueta ekodifite kobererau ibifisu.
